title: Quick Smoky Ethiopian Beef Stew
description: A charred, smoky beef stew packed with Ethiopian flavors, served straight from a mason jar for a lazy Sunday meal.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: use smoked salt for extra depth

instructions: Heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat and add olive oil.
Sear the beef cubes until browned on all sides, then remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, add onions and cook until translucent.
Stir in minced garlic, grated ginger, and tomato paste, letting it cook for 2 minutes.
Add berbere, smoked paprika, salt, pepper, and bay leaf, stirring to coat the aromatics.
Transfer the beef, aromatics, and liquid to the mason jar, adding beef broth and water.
Seal the jar, shake gently, and place it in a preheated oven at 400°F for 20 minutes to simmer and infuse flavors.
Remove from oven, open the jar, stir, and serve hot garnished with cilantro.
